senses.gloss:
चोर, अस्, m. a thief, a robber; N. of a plant, =
कृष्ण-शटी; a kind of perfume, = चोरक; N. of a
poet; (आ), f., N. of a plant, = चोर-पुष्पी; (ई), f. a
female thief; [cf. चौर; cf. also Gr. φώρ.]
—चोर-
[]
कण्टक, अस्, m. a kind of grass, the seeds of which
stick in the clothes, commonly Chorkānta.
—चोर-
पुष्पिका or चोर-पुष्पी, f. the plant Chrysopogon
Aciculatus.
—चोर-स्नायु, उस्, m. a plant, = काक-
नासा.
चोर चोर, &c. See rt. चुर्, p. 328, col. 1.

चोरक, अस्, m. a thief; a kind of plant [cf. पृक्का
and तस्कर]; a kind of perfume.

चोरितक, अम्, n. thieving, petty theft or larceny;
anything stolen.

चोरायित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. a Nom. चोराय), acted
like a thief, playing the thief.
